hypothesis: Explicit compiler optimization levels and trace replay improve flow inference.
scope: Single random-weight FP32 dense DiT block, 64 active tokens, width 1536, 12 heads, 1029 context tokens; synchronized input/output transfers included. No trained LoRA. Single exposed Wormhole chip.
timing_method: Five calls after first inference and one warmup. Single process per configuration, hardware access serialized. Compilation/kernel caches not cleared.
decision: No default change. Levels 0/1/2 are within observed timing noise at this small shape. Trace replay is about 5% faster in this one comparison; needs full-flow confirmation.
quality_scope: Operator smoke gate only; no trajectory or scene-quality claim.
next: Compare stock/merged pretrained complete shape flow, then real-size synthetic token counts and matched trajectories.
